label: accepted

evidence.V1: Ladder-back chair with gold finials reads instantly from front, three-quarter, top and silhouette; front outline symmetric, A15 X error 0.0.
evidence.V2: Clear: big = seat slab and back frame, medium = three back slats, top rail and stretchers, small = gold ball finials and chamfered edges.
evidence.V3: Mostly stiff primitives: straight untapered square legs and posts, flat seat with no dish or overhang shaping, plain boxed slats; only the finials add stylisation.
evidence.V4: Consistent ~0.05-stud chamfers on seat rim, posts, rails and slats that catch the light (seat and back close-ups).
evidence.V5: Wood surfaces are clean, but the gold finial balls are visibly low-poly: faceted outline and a flat polygon cap on top (finial close-up, studio and flat) - minor stray faceting.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: wood hue in 3 values (light slats/seat, mid posts, dark top rail) plus gold accent; painted colourways keep the structure.
evidence.V7: 548 tris vs medium target 2000 / ceiling 4000 - well under target.
evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor material, smooth shading, chamfered hard edges, wood hue with kit gold #E8AE38-style finials - matches the furniture kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, CollisionFidelity Box, CanTouch off, CastShadow on, Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre (with note to add a Seat if sittable).

artifacts: faceted low-poly finial spheres with a flat top cap
top_fixes: Raise the finial sphere segment count (budget allows) so the gold balls read round with no flat cap
Add stylisation to the frame: taper or turn the legs, slightly splay or curve the back posts, give the seat a soft dish or rounded front edge
Vary slat widths or add a shaped top rail so the back reads less like a plain ladder of boxes
